manifest.name: 服务看板
manifest.author: Yggdrasil
manifest.description: 示例插件：一个声明式端点 + 一个 js 工具 + 一块自带界面（把三者凑在一起看它们怎么配合）。

fields.label: 更新地址前缀（可选）
fields.hint: 填你这个应用自己的地址（浏览器地址栏里的那个源）。更新清单与新版包都放在应用的 /plugins/ 下，所以这样填就能真的演示一次"检查更新 -> 确认安装"。

fields.label: GitHub Token（1.1 新增，可选）
fields.hint: 1.1 新增的密钥字段 —— 升级确认里应当能看见它。

endpoints.name: rate_limit
endpoints.label: 探活（GitHub 限流）
endpoints.description: GET api.github.com/rate_limit — a small, fast, key-less endpoint that proves the declarative path works end to end. Returns resources.core.{limit,remaining,reset}. Without an API token the limit is 60 requests per hour, so a low remaining is normal, not a bug.

endpoints.name: repo_info
endpoints.label: 查仓库（1.1 新增）
endpoints.description: Reposilite — added in 1.1 so the upgrade diff has something to show. GET api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}.

tools.name: summarise
tools.label: 统计并整理
tools.description: A **js tool**: takes a list of numbers (comma separated) and returns count / sum / min / max / average, plus a short human sentence. Runs in a sandboxed Worker with no network of its own, so it needs no host. Use it when you want arithmetic that you would rather not do in your head, or as the data step before rendering a board.

tools.name: probe
tools.label: 联网探活（经白名单）
tools.description: A **js tool that needs the network**: it calls ctx.fetch() to hit api.github.com/rate_limit, measures how long it took and returns {ms, status, remaining}. ctx.fetch is the only network path a js tool has, and the main thread checks the host against the plugin allow-list — that is the difference between "the sandbox can reach what the plugin declared" and "the sandbox can reach anything".

ui.name: board
ui.label: 状态看板
ui.description: A screen this plugin ships: renders a small board with the title from the plugin field and whatever data you pass. Put it on the desktop with plugin_ui("status-board", "board", data).
ui.dataDoc: { title?: string; rows?: { label: string; value: string }[] }

guide:
# status-board

A demo plugin that uses all three plugin capabilities at once, so you can see how they combine.
Everything it touches is **api.github.com** — a fast, key-less, CORS-enabled endpoint — so a failed call means
something is wrong here, not that the demo host is down.

| capability | what it is here |
| --- | --- |
| declarative endpoint | `status-board.rate_limit` — a plain GET, no parameters |
| **js tool** | `status-board.summarise` (pure calculation) and `status-board.probe` (does a network call through `ctx.fetch`) |
| **shipped interface** | the `board` screen — a TSX module the plugin carries, put on screen with `plugin_ui` |

## The update field

The plugin panel has an **update address prefix** field. When the user fills it with this app's own origin
(e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:19387`), the panel's "check for updates" reads
`<that address>/plugins/status-board.version.json` and can install version 1.1 from it.
That field is in the host allow-list as `{config:update_base}`, so updates do not open a new network door —
the user's own value defines it.

## Workflow

1. `status-board.summarise` with the numbers the user mentioned → you get count/sum/min/max/average.
2. `plugin_ui` with `id: "status-board"`, `ui: "board"`, and `data`:

       { "title": "今天的数字", "rows": [ { "label": "合计", "value": "23" } ] }

3. Fill the rows from whatever you actually computed. **Do not invent values** — the board shows exactly what
   you pass, so a wrong number is a wrong board.

## About the js tools

- `summarise` runs in a sandboxed Worker with **no network of its own**; it only sees the arguments and the
  plugin fields. Use it for arithmetic instead of doing it in your head.
- `probe` calls `ctx.fetch` to `api.github.com/rate_limit` — that is the plugin's only way out to the network,
  and the main thread checks the host against the plugin allow-list. A refusal is a plugin configuration problem,
  not something you can work around.
- A js tool that throws or times out comes back as a failed operation with the error text; report that text.

## The board is plugin code

`plugin_ui` creates a **locked** window: patch_source on it will be refused. If the board needs a different
look, tell the user to unlock it in the Nodes panel, or use a normal component instead.

files.README.md:
这是**更新夹具**，不是给人单独安装的插件：它的 id 与 status-board 相同、版本是 1.1，
用来演示"检查更新 -> 看到权限差异 -> 确认安装"。构建脚本会把它打成
public/plugins/status-board-1.1.graft，清单文件则是 public/plugins/status-board.version.json。
